> This is a line-by-line accountant's audit of the **current `main` branch** codebase, followed by a precise implementation plan. I have read every file in the repo.

## Part 1: Audit Findings (Defects & Gaps)

### 🔴 CRITICAL — Accounting Engine Defects in [local.ts](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/db/local.ts)

#### Defect 1: No Customer / Debtor concept exists at all
The database has **only** `suppliers` (creditors). There is no `customers` collection, no `type` field on parties, and no concept of "credit sale to a customer". The `sale-form.tsx` records a flat amount + notes — it has **no party field, no cash/credit toggle, no invoice status**.

**Impact:** You cannot sell on credit. You cannot track who owes you money. There are zero Debtors (Accounts Receivable) anywhere in the app.

---

#### Defect 2: Cash in Hand formula ignores customer receipts
In [local.ts L225](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/db/local.ts#L225):
```typescript
const cash = +(openingCash + totalSales - supplierPayments - drawings).toFixed(2);
```
This treats **every sale as cash received instantly**. In reality:
- A **cash sale** adds to Cash in Hand immediately
- A **credit sale** adds to Accounts Receivable, NOT Cash
- A **customer payment (receipt)** moves money from Receivables → Cash

Currently the formula has no concept of this split, so if you ever add credit sales, the cash figure will be **overstated** by the total of all unpaid credit sales.

---

#### Defect 3: Net Profit formula subtracts Drawings — that's wrong
In [local.ts L221](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/db/local.ts#L221):
```typescript
const netProfit = +(grossProfit - commission - drawings).toFixed(2);
```

4. **Employee Report calculates inventory variance, not gross profit** — The formula is `Actual Stock - Expected Stock`, which is variance, not profit.

- Sale form has no customer/party selector (vs bill form which has supplier selection)
- No duplicate name prevention on party creation
- Edit/delete UI differs across every screen — no consistent modal
- "Staff" tab is a hardcoded inventory report, not the configurable custom report you need

#### Defect 1: No Customer / Debtor concept exists at all
The database has **only** `suppliers` (creditors). There is no `customers` collection, no `type` field on parties, and no concept of "credit sale to a customer". The `sale-form.tsx` records a flat amount + notes — it has **no party field, no cash/credit toggle, no invoice status**.

**Impact:** You cannot sell on credit. You cannot track who owes you money. There are zero Debtors (Accounts Receivable) anywhere in the app.

---

#### Defect 2: Cash in Hand formula ignores customer receipts
In [local.ts L225](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/db/local.ts#L225):
```typescript
const cash = +(openingCash + totalSales - supplierPayments - drawings).toFixed(2);
```
This treats **every sale as cash received instantly**. In reality:
- A **cash sale** adds to Cash in Hand immediately
- A **credit sale** adds to Accounts Receivable, NOT Cash
- A **customer payment (receipt)** moves money from Receivables → Cash

Currently the formula has no concept of this split, so if you ever add credit sales, the cash figure will be **overstated** by the total of all unpaid credit sales.

---

#### Defect 3: Net Profit formula subtracts Drawings — that's wrong
In [local.ts L221](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/db/local.ts#L221):
```typescript
const netProfit = +(grossProfit - commission - drawings).toFixed(2);
```

"# Ledgr-AI — Master App System Prompt & Product Specification

> **Single Source of Truth** for Ledgr AI. Captures the complete history, requirements, accounting logic, schema definitions, and prompt specification for present and future development.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Vision

**Ledgr-AI** is a mobile-first, AI-assisted, offline-capable accounting and bookkeeping application built with **React Native (Expo SDK 54)** and **SQLite (`expo-sqlite`)**.

It is designed for a **global audience** of small business owners, retail shopkeepers, freelancers, handy men, service providers, and multi-partner retail businesses.

### Core Principles
1. **AI & Voice-First UX:** Ultra-simple natural language voice and text input for users who are not tech-savvy or accounting-trained.
2. **Dual Accounting Engine:**
   - **Mode A: Shop Partnership Mode (Investor & Shopkeeper Model)**
     - Periodic physical inventory audits (irregular intervals).
     - 50/50 Partner Capital Accounts (e.g. Amit & Rahim with different opening stakes, e.g. $90,184.97 & $109,942.12).
     - Shopkeeper (Aheshan) salary + commission % on Gross Profit.
     - Net Profit = Gross Profit - Commission - Expenses (Drawings reduce Capital, NOT Net Profit).
     - Books close snapshot with closing balances carried forward to next period as opening balances.
   - **Mode B: Standard Accounting Mode (Regular Way)**
     - Standard Accrual/Cash P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, Debtors, Creditors, Equity.
3. **Unified Parties System:**
   - Single authoritative `v2_parties` table tracking both Customers (Debtors / Accounts Receivable) and Suppliers (Creditors / Accounts Payable).
   - Prevents duplicate party names; seamlessly auto-links transactions across Sales, Invoices, Receipts, Bills, and Payments.
4. **Dynamic Business Personas & Multi-Book Accounts:**
   - Onboarding allows choosing personas (Retail, Wholesale, Salon, Handyman, Tech/Freelancer, Vendor, Custom).

### Complete Audit & Implementation Summary

I have thoroughly investigated your repository, audited the `v2-roadmap-ready` branch, and implemented the required fixes and features to fulfill your accounting vision.

---

### What Was Investigated & Fixed

#### 1. **V2 Dashboard & Reporting Tile Integration Fix (`api.ts` & `v2Dashboard.ts`)**
- **Issue Identified**: `api.dashboard()`, `api.pnl()`, `api.balanceSheet()`, and `api.trialBalance()` were previously hardcoded to read only legacy AsyncStorage arrays. When transactions or parties were created in V2 SQLite, the home page tiles (Sales, Purchases, Cash, Debtors, Creditors, Net Worth) were not updating!
- **Fix**: Built a dedicated `getV2Dashboard` module ([v2Dashboard.ts](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/accountingV2/v2Dashboard.ts)) and updated [api.ts](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/api.ts). Whenever V2 SQLite is active, `api.dashboard()` and all report functions pull directly from the V2 double-entry journal, so sales, invoices, payments, and parties immediately reflect across all tiles.

#### 2. **Dual Accounting Engine Support**
- **Mode A: Shop Partnership (Your Way)**
  - Periodic physical inventory audit (irregular intervals).
  - 50/50 Partner Capital Accounts (e.g., Amit & Rahim with different opening capital contributions, e.g. $90,184.97 & $109,942.12).
  - Shopkeeper (Aheshan) salary + commission % on gross profit.
  - Net Profit = Gross Profit - Commission - Expenses (Drawings reduce Capital, NOT Net Profit).
  - Periodic close-books snapshot carrying forward closing balances (cash, stock, receivables, payables) as next period's opening balances.
- **Mode B: Standard Accounting (Regular Way)**
  - Standard P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, Debtors, Creditors, and generic single/multi-owner equity.
- **Onboarding & Settings Toggle**: You can select your accounting style during onboarding (`onboarding.tsx`) or switch styles anytime in Settings.

#### 3. **Unified Parties System (`v2_parties`)**
- Unified customer (Debtor) & supplier (Creditor) directory.
- `createParty` in [api.ts](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/src/api.ts) prevents duplicate name generation and automatically links credit sales, invoices, receipts, and payments across the database, home page tiles, and party statements.

#### 4. **Executive Custom Report & PDF Generator (`custom-report.tsx`)**
- **Issue Identified**: The custom report previously printed plain text in a `<pre>` HTML tag ("rubbish format").
- **Fix**: Upgraded [custom-report.tsx](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/app/custom-report.tsx) to build an executive-level PDF matching your `accounts_shop.html` design:
  - Dark emerald header (`#1C4030`), clear section banners, structured financial tables with right-aligned tabular numbers, and footer timestamps.
  - Configurable section selection (P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, Staff Inventory Flow, Debtors, Creditors, Partner Capital).
  - Clean text generator for WhatsApp sharing.

#### 5. **Master Application Prompt File (`LEDGR_AI_MASTER_PROMPT.md`)**
- Created [LEDGR_AI_MASTER_PROMPT.md](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/LEDGR_AI_MASTER_PROMPT.md) in the root of your repository. It contains the single source of truth prompt, accounting math, database schemas, persona definitions, and full request history for future AI assistance.

## Executive Summary
This document records the exact accounting architecture, business persona specs, SQLite V2 integration requirements, and conversation history for the **Ledgr AI** application repository.

   - Stock counts recorded periodically.
   - Shrinkage / Inventory Variance = `Expected Stock (Opening + Purchases - Sales) - Actual Physical Audit`.

   - When closing an accounting period:
     - Net Profit is calculated (`Gross Profit - Commission - Operating Expenses`).
     - Net Profit is allocated 50/50 to partner capital accounts.
     - Period close snapshot freezes ledger history, resets revenue/expense counters, and carries forward closing asset & capital balances to the next period.

args.ReplacementContent:
"## 1. Core Accounting Modes

### A. Partner Equity & Profit-Split Accounting
1. **50/50 Partner Equity Accounts**:
   - Primary Partners: **Amit** & **Rahim** (or user-customized partners).
   - Standing Capital Formula: `Opening Capital + Net Profit Share − Partner Drawings`.
2. **Periodic Physical Inventory Stock Audit**:
   - Stock counts recorded periodically.
   - Shrinkage / Inventory Variance = `Expected Stock (Opening + Purchases - Sales) - Actual Physical Audit`.
3. **Shopkeeper Salary & Manager Commission %**:
   - Manager Commission % calculated directly on **Gross Profit** (`(Sales Revenue - Cost of Goods Sold) * Commission %`).
   - Manager commission sits as an accrued liability until settled via commission payments.
4. **Period Close Snapshot & Carry Forward**:
   - When closing an accounting period:
     - Net Profit is calculated (`Gross Profit - Commission - Operating Expenses`).
     - Net Profit is allocated 50/50 to partner capital accounts.
     - Period close snapshot freezes ledger history, resets revenue/expense counters, and carries forward closing asset & capital balances to the next period.

### B. Standard Entity & Single-Owner Accounting
1. **Standard Accrual P&L**: Revenue recognized upon sale (both cash sales and credit invoices).
2. **Balance Sheet**: Assets (Cash, Accounts Receivable, Inventory) = Liabilities (Accounts Payable, Expenses Payable) + Equity.
3. **Trial Balance**: Verifies double-entry equality (`Total Debits = Total Credits`).
4. **Single-Owner & General Small Business Ledger**: Ideal for freelancers, handyman services, salons, and consultants."

In standard accounting, a **Debtor's (Customer's) Credit Sale** is split between the **Profit & Loss Statement** and the **Balance Sheet (Assets)** as follows:

---

### 1. How Debtors Affect **PROFIT** (Profit & Loss Statement)
When you make a credit sale of **$100** to a debtor:
- **Sales Revenue**: Increases immediately by **+$100** on the date of sale.
- **Gross Profit**: `Sales Revenue − Cost of Goods Sold` (increases by **+$100**).
- **Net Profit**: `Gross Profit − Expenses` (increases by **+$100**).

> 💡 **Key Rule**: Under standard accounting (Accrual Basis), **profit is recognized on the date the invoice is created**, regardless of whether the customer pays cash today or next month.

---

### 2. How Debtors Sit in **ASSETS** (Balance Sheet)
Until the customer actually pays you, the unpaid amount sits under **CURRENT ASSETS**:

$$\text{Total Assets} = \text{Cash in Hand} + \underbrace{\mathbf{\text{Accounts Receivable (Debtors)}}}_{\text{Money Owed to You}} + \text{Inventory}$$

- **Debtor Outstanding Balance = Current Asset**: It represents money that legally belongs to your business, even though it hasn't entered your cash box yet.

---

### 3. What Happens When the Debtor Pays You (Record Payment)?

When the customer pays you the **$100** cash:

1. **Debtors Asset**: Decreases by **-$100** (their balance goes to $0).
2. **Cash in Hand (Asset)**: Increases by **+$100**.
3. **Profit**: **Does NOT change again** (because the $100 profit was already counted on the day of sale).

$$\text{Net Asset Change} = (-\$100 \text{ Debtors}) + (+\$100 \text{ Cash}) = \$0$$

---

### Quick Summary Matrix

| Transaction | Profit (P&L) | Cash in Hand (Asset) | Debtors (Asset) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Credit Sale ($100)** | **+$100** (Revenue) | $0 | **+$100** (Receivable) |
| **Customer Payment ($100)** | $0 (No double count) | **+$100** | **-$100** (Cleared) |

### Why it wasn't showing earlier & How we fixed it

#### 1. The Disconnect in the App
Earlier, when you created an invoice or credit sale inside **Debtors**:
- It updated the **Customer Statement** and **Outstanding Balance** (Accounts Receivable).
- **BUT** the main **Sales & Profit tiles on the Home Screen** were filtered to only count cash-in-hand transactions, or were defaulting to "Cash Basis" mode instead of "Accrual Basis" mode.

---

#### 2. How it works now in the app (Standard Accounting)
With the latest updates we applied:

1. **When you create an Invoice / Credit Sale ($100)**:
   - **Sales Tile (Home Screen)**: Increases by **+$100** immediately.
   - **Profit Tile (Home Screen)**: Increases by **+$100** immediately.
   - **Debtors Outstanding Balance**: Shows **+$100** (Current Asset).
   - **Cash Tile**: Remains **$0.00** (because money hasn't entered your bank/hand yet).

2. **When you tap "Record Payment" from the Customer ($100)**:
   - **Cash Tile**: Increases by **+$100** (Cash in Hand).
   - **Debtors Outstanding Balance**: Decreases to **$0.00** (cleared).
   - **Sales & Profit**: Stay at **$100** (so profit is never double-counted).

---

### Summary
Now, every credit sale created anywhere in the app immediately reflects in **Sales Revenue**, **Net Profit**, and **Debtors Balance**, exactly as standard accounting requires.

### Web Deletion Bug Discovered & Fixed!

#### 🔍 Root Cause
In React Native Web (running at `localhost:8081`), the default `Alert.alert` implementation displays a simple browser alert box (`window.alert`) with an "OK" button, **ignoring the multi-button `onPress` callbacks** (`Cancel` / `Delete`). As a result, clicking the trash icon on Web appeared to do nothing because the delete action callback was never executed.

---

#### 🛠️ Solution Applied
Added a cross-platform confirmation helper `confirmAction` to [app/debtors.tsx](file:///c:/Users/just2/Downloads/ledgr_ai/frontend/app/debtors.tsx#L191-L203):
- **On Web (`localhost:8081`)**: Uses `window.confirm(message)`. When you click **OK**, it executes `api.deleteInvoice(inv.id)` / `api.deleteDebtor` / `api.deleteDebtorPayment` instantly and reloads the statement balance.
- **On Mobile (iOS & Android)**: Continues using native `Alert.alert` with destructive red confirmation styling.

---

### Test It Now
1. Refresh your browser (`Ctrl + R`).
2. Go to **Debtors** → Click your Customer `123`.
3. Tap the **Trash Icon** next to `Invoice • Jul 26, 2026 • INV-0001`.
4. Click **OK** on the browser prompt — the invoice will be deleted immediately and the debtor balance will update!

"### Turn 6: Credit Sale / Invoice Deletion Fix Across Sales & Debtors
- **User Prompt**: *"when trying to delete this is pop up i get and as soon i click ok nothing hpnds... and strange thing is same i can delete from debtors and it goes away from debtors but still reflects under sales tile"*
- **Audit Findings**:
  1. `listSales()` combines both **Cash Sales** and **Invoices / Credit Sales** (`Credit Sale (...)`).
  2. Previously, `deleteSale(id)` assumed every item on the Sales screen was a pure cash sale and called `salesCrud.remove(id)` or `reverseSource(id, 'cash_sale')`.
  3. When attempting to delete a **Credit Sale / Invoice** from the Sales tab, `deleteSale` looked for `id` in `sales` / `cash_sale` sources, failed to find it, and returned without deleting the invoice underlying record.
  4. Furthermore, unhandled exceptions inside the confirmation action prevented `setSelected(null)` and `load()` from closing the detail view.
- **Resolutions**:
  1. Updated `deleteSale` and `updateSale` in `local.ts` and `appService.ts` to inspect record types (`cash_sale`, `credit_sale`, `invoice`) and delegate to `deleteInvoice` / `reverseSource('invoice')` when deleting a credit sale.
  2. Wrapped `reverseSale` in `sales.tsx` in a `try...catch` block with user feedback alerts.
  3. All unit tests passed (31/31) and updates were pushed to `v3.0`.

---

*Document generated by Antigravity AI Assistant.*"

This caused printed invoices to look like they lacked carry-forward logic.

  2. Updated `app/(tabs)/reports.tsx`'s `Live — Current Period` Summary card to explicitly show **Outstanding Debtors**, and renamed *Outstanding Payables* to **Creditors** to match legacy conventions.
  3. Refactored `getPrevBalance(inv)` out of `sharePdf` in `invoices.tsx` and applied it to `printInvoice` so both Web Printing and PDF Sharing display accurate "Previous Balance (carried fwd)" and "Balance Due" lines on the invoice.

### 🔍 Root Cause Identified & Fixed!

Here is why clicking **OK** on the popup previously did nothing for that specific entry:

1. **Why it was happening**: The Sales list displays both **Cash Sales** AND **Credit Sales / Invoices** (e.g. `Credit Sale (123)` as shown in your screenshot).
2. Previously, `deleteSale(id)` assumed every entry on the Sales screen was a simple cash sale and tried to delete it from the cash sales table. 
3. When you tried to delete a **Credit Sale / Invoice**, `deleteSale` couldn't find the ID in cash sales, so it returned without touching the underlying invoice record! That's why it deleted fine from Debtors (which targeted the invoice directly), but failed when clicked from the Sales screen.

---

### 🛠️ What Was Done

1. **Intelligent `deleteSale` & `updateSale` Router**:
   - Updated both `frontend/src/db/local.ts` and `frontend/src/accountingV2/appService.ts` to inspect the sale entry ID type (`cash_sale`, `credit_sale`, `invoice`).
   - If the item selected in Sales is an **Invoice / Credit Sale**, `deleteSale` now automatically routes the deletion to `deleteInvoice()`, properly reversing both the invoice and debtor entries simultaneously!
2. **Error Handling**:
   - Added explicit `try...catch` blocks to `reverseSale` so any deletion error will provide visual feedback instead of freezing the UI.
3. **Pushed to GitHub**:
   - All 31 test suites passed clean and the fix has been pushed to your **`v3.0`** branch!

---

### 🧪 Test It Now
Please **refresh your browser (`Ctrl + R`)** at `localhost:8081`, tap **Reversal/Delete** on any Credit Sale or Cash Sale, click **OK**, and it will now delete cleanly and instantly vanish from both Sales and Debtors!

"# Invoice and Report Styling Walkthrough

I have overhauled the PDF/HTML layouts for your invoices and reports to perfectly match the high-end dark blue (`#1e202c`) and yellow (`#fcc145`) theme! 

## Features Implemented

### Editable Invoice Terms & Conditions
- Added a new field to `Settings` > `Business Profile` for `Invoice Terms & Conditions`. 
- By default, it says `"Payment is due upon receipt. Please include the invoice number on your check or payment reference."` but you can now customize this easily.

### Invoice Layout (`invoices.tsx`)
- Completely replaced the plain HTML generator.
- Added a prominent **Header** section (white on left for the logo, dark blue on the right for your business info).
- Added a clean **Yellow Bar** that highlights the Total Due, Invoice Date, and Due Date.
- Updated the main table to feature a dark blue header with yellow text, and alternating white/light-grey rows for line items.
- Structured the footer to neatly display your custom **Terms & Conditions** and your **Payment Details** with a "Thank you for your business!" badge.

### Custom Reports Layout (`custom-report.tsx`)
- Replaced the basic table structure with a stylized multi-section layout mimicking your legacy `accounts_shop.html` detail modals.
- Introduced dark blue and yellow header bands (`Financial Statement`), stylized section headers, and improved typography.
- Alternating row backgrounds and clearer column alignments make reading financial figures much easier.

### Summary Reports Layout (`reports.tsx`)
- Updated the standard `PDF / Print` output on the dashboard to use the same dark blue/yellow aesthetic as the Custom Reports.
- Replaced simple borders with rich section headers (grey background, left yellow border) and bolder text layouts for assets/liabilities/income/expenses.

## Next Steps

To verify these changes:
1. Try generating a PDF invoice from the **Sales/Invoices** page.
2. Go to **Settings** and modify the `Invoice Terms & Conditions`, then preview another

"# Stylization and Provider Settings Walkthrough

I have made additional updates to clean up UI labels, improve settings flexibility, and add robust authentication guards.

## Summary of Changes

### 1. Simplified Tax Label Settings
- Removed the predefined chips ("None", "GST", "VAT", "Custom" etc.).
- Replaced the interface with a single text field: **Tax Label** (e.g. GST, VAT) and a conditional **Tax Rate %** field.
- If you clear the Tax Label input, tax is completely disabled.
- Gracefully migrates any existing tax settings on load.

### 2. Blank Default Members (No Amit & Rahim)
- Changed the backend database defaults for `partnerNames` to be empty (`[]`) by default, rather than starting with `['Amit', 'Rahim']`.
- The settings screen now starts with a completely clean members list.

### 3. Verification of "Built by AI" or "Emergent" mentions
- Cleaned up the main Dashboard header subtitle, changing it from `"Shop accounting, AI-fast"` to `"Simple shop accounting"`.
- Verified that reports do not reference "Ledgr AI Accounting" or "emergent".

### 4. Reset Data Device Lock Security
- Updated the `Reset All Data` action in the settings tab to call `requireAuth`.
- The system will now prompt you for your phone's biometric authentication/device PIN before resetting database tables (matching the security guard on other destructive actions like deleting files or accounts).

### 5. Added Custom Anthropic Provider
- Added a `custom_anthropic` (Anthropic-compatible Custom API) choice to the `PROVIDERS` list.
- Updated `settings.tsx` to display the custom **Base URL** input whenever either `Custom (OpenAI-compatible)` or `Custom (Anthropic-compatible)` is selected.

---
All 198 Jest tests run and pass successfully!"

"# Dashboard Date Filter & Theme System Walkthrough

I have implemented the **Dashboard Date Filter** and the **App & Invoice Theme Customization**, including the new Navy & Gold theme!

---

## 1. Home Page Date Range Filter

A new **Period Filter Bar** is now available directly on the Home Page (`index.tsx`), right above the Net Profit hero card:

- **Quick Chips**: `All Time`, `Today`, `This Month`, `Custom Period`.
- **Custom Range**: When selecting `Custom Period`, start (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and end (`YYYY-MM-DD`) date fields appear with a **Filter** button.
- **Dynamic KPI Recalculation**: Selecting any period dynamically recalculates the **Net Profit**, **Sales**, **Purchases (COGS)**, **Gross Profit**, **Manager Commission**, and **Drawings** cards for that exact timeframe without altering your global period settings!

---

## 2. App & Invoice Theme System

### App Theme Selection
You can now customize the visual theme of the application interface under **Settings > App & Invoice Themes**:
- **Emerald Light** (Classic Light Mode)
- **Emerald Dark** (Classic Dark Mode)
- **Navy & Gold** *(New! Navy `#1e202c` background with Gold `#fcc145` accents)*
- **System Default**

### Invoice PDF Theme Selection
You can also choose the style of printed or shared invoice PDFs under **Settings > App & Invoice Themes**:
- **Navy & Gold** *(Default: Navy header with Gold banner and totals)*
- **Classic Emerald** *(Emerald Green header & accents)*
- **Clean Minimal** *(Monochrome black/white layout)*

---

## Verification & Testing

- **Automated Tests**: Ran `npm test` across all 31 test suites (198 unit tests). **100% Passed**.
- **Interactive Dev Server**: Expo dev server is running on `http://localhost:8081`. You can test changing themes in Settings and selecting different period ranges on the Dashboard!"

---

## 2. In-App Reports Screen (`reports.tsx`)

- **Liabilities & Creditors Card**: Structured section displaying Suppliers Payable (Creditors) and registered suppliers.
- **Partner Capital Reconciliation**: Structured breakdown of opening capital, net profit share, drawings, and closing capital.

---

- **Unit Tests**: All 198 Jest tests passed cleanly (`31 passed, 31 total`).

"# Invoice Format & Theme Updates Walkthrough

I have implemented the exact format changes you requested for the invoices, specifically focusing on the PDF export and WhatsApp sharing formats. 

---

## 1. Professional PDF Invoice Format
- **Dynamic App Theme Matching**: When you generate a PDF or share the invoice via WhatsApp, the PDF now dynamically inherits the active App Theme colors (`#1e202c` & `#fcc145` for Navy & Gold). It automatically uses these brand colors for the header background, accent banners, totals box, and footer lines.
- **Beautiful Corporate Design**: I have rewritten the `buildHtml` engine to output a highly professional, beautiful invoice template. It includes a dedicated `INVOICE TO` section, an accent banner for the Total Due, nicely formatted line-item grids, and a clean signature area. 

## 2. New Inputs: Line Item Units & Invoice Terms
- **Line Item Units**: When creating or editing an invoice, there is now an input field next to Quantity for the **Unit**. You can manually type in `pcs`, `dzn`, `bag`, `sac`, etc. 
- **Invoice Terms**: I have added a dedicated **Invoice Terms** field inside the "Notes" section of the form. This allows you to edit the Terms & Conditions section at the bottom of the invoice manually for each individual invoice. If left blank, it will fall back to your default settings.

## 3. In-App Preview Reverted
- The in-app preview for the invoice detail view has been reverted to use the standard responsive `Card` style that cleanly inherits the App Theme, as you requested.

---
All 198 Jest tests have run and passed successfully!"
